_about: Public-domain James Henry Snowden (1852-1936), Presbyterian professor at Western Theological Seminary, Pittsburgh, and editor of the Presbyterian Banner, for the Word Hoard: Scenes and Sayings in the Life of Christ, The World a Spiritual System, The Basal Beliefs of Christianity, The Psychology of Religion, Can We Believe in Immortality?, Is the World Growing Better?, A Wonderful Night, The Coming of the Lord: Will it be Premillennial?, The Truth about Christian Science, The Personality of God, The Attractions of the Ministry, The Meaning of Education, Jesus as Judged by his Enemies, The Making and Meaning of the New Testament, and A Summer across the Sea. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 114 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
